bundle.author: stephtea
bundle.title: Broker: record and replay page fetches for Universal Judge runs
bundle.body:
The Universal Judge runs a PR's base and candidate arms over an hour apart, so the pages an agent fetches change in between, and the verdict measures that drift along with the code. #2675 put a `replay` setting on judge tickets. This PR makes `/http/fetch` and `/http/head` act on it: a `record` ticket saves what the base arm fetched, and a `replay` ticket serves the candidate those same responses.

How it behaves, and why:

- **Failures fall back to live.** A failed save never touches the live response, because saving happens after the response is sent. A replay read that fails for any reason, including a missing or malformed recording, reads as a miss and fetches live. Replay can make a run less noisy, but it should never break one.
- **Late base writes don't count.** A base case that outlives its poll keeps fetching. So a recording is served only if S3 wrote it before the replaying ticket was issued. That keeps the result independent of timing, with no coordination between arms.
- **First response wins.** Subagents and broker tasks fetch the same page in parallel. The body is written with `IfNoneMatch`, and only the writer that created it writes its metadata, so a recording never pairs one response's body with another's headers.
- **Only responses under 400 are saved.** A challenge page or a 503 the base arm hit may be transient, so the candidate gets its own try, and that counts as a miss.
- **Matching uses a normalized URL.** The fragment and tracking parameters are dropped, the scheme and host lowercased and the query sorted. The live fetch still goes to the URL the agent sent.
- **Outcome markers carry hit or miss only, never a URL,** under `<key>/outcomes/<run_id>/`. The judge can then report a hit rate per candidate run without putting URLs in a public report.
- **`REPLAY_ENABLED` is checked on every request,** not just at mint, so turning it off stops runs already in flight.

**The caps.** The owner chose 500 objects and 500 MB per replay key, and downloads over 50 MB are not saved. The broker has no ListBucket, so it can't count a key's objects. Instead it counts saves on the recording run's ticket item, atomically across tasks, and only saves that create an object count. One run records each key, so this is the per-key cap in practice. A redelivered dispatch on the same key would get a second budget, but write-once saves mean it can only add pages the first run didn't save.

**Ship order.** This depends on #2675, which is merged. Retention for `_judge/` is #2676, and it should merge first. Nothing sends `record` or `replay` until the dispatch Lambda (next PR) and the judge (after that) ship, so this is inert in prod and on dev until then.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes SSRF-guarded egress (`/http/fetch`, `/http/head`) with S3/DynamoDB side effects for judge tickets; failures are designed to fall back to live, but replay bugs could affect eval fairness or artifact bucket usage in dev.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds **page fetch record/replay** for Universal Judge runs so candidate arms see the same web responses as the base arm, instead of live pages that drift over time.
> 
> When a scope ticket carries `replay` and `REPLAY_ENABLED=true`, **`record`** writes successful (`<400`) `/http/fetch` and `/http/head` responses to S3 under the ticket’s `_judge/replay/` key (after the response is sent); **`replay`** serves those bytes instead of calling Playwright or httpx. Lookups use **normalized URLs**; misses, corrupt data, late base writes, or cap exhaustion **fall back to live**. Replay requests emit **hit/miss markers** (no URLs) for the judge.
> 
> New **`PageReplay`** (`broker/page_replay.py`) handles S3 layout, write-once races, DynamoDB **per-run caps** (500 objects / 500 MB; downloads over 50 MB not recorded), and shared **`replay_enabled()`** used at mint and on every HTTP request. **`main.py`** wires the dependency; **`ARCHITECTURE.md`** documents the behavior.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 5f578185d37c6b1203d2dbe7d6ea290d847c5336. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

diff --git a/packages/gp-ai/broker/page_replay.py b/packages/gp-ai/broker/page_replay.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..de769ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/gp-ai/broker/page_replay.py
@@ -0,0 +1,324 @@
+"""Record and replay of page fetches for Universal Judge runs.
+
+A judge run's ticket can carry a `replay` setting (`JudgeReplayRef`): `record`
+saves each successful `/http/fetch` and `/http/head` response under the
+ticket's store key, and `replay` serves the saved copy instead of fetching
+live. Every failure here reads as "no recording": a record that fails leaves
+the live response alone, and a replay read that fails fetches live.
+
+Layout under `<key>/` in the artifacts bucket:
+
+- `fetch/<sha256>.body` and `fetch/<sha256>.json`: a fetched body and its
+  response metadata. The body is written first with `IfNoneMatch`, so it is
+  the lock: only the writer that created it writes the metadata, and a
+  metadata object always describes the body beside it.
+- `head/<sha256>.json`: a HEAD check's status and final URL.
+- `outcomes/<run_id>/<fetch|head>-<hit|miss>-<uuid>`: one empty marker per
+  replay-mode request, counted by the judge. Markers never carry a URL.
+
+`<sha256>` hashes the normalized requested URL, so a redirect is matched on
+where the agent asked to go, and the recorded final URL is served unchanged.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import hashlib
+import logging
+import os
+import uuid
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal, TypeVar
+from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlencode, urlsplit, urlunsplit
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+from broker.dynamodb_client import JudgeReplayRef, ScopeTicket
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+# Per recording run. Only saves that create an object count, so a URL
+# fetched twice costs one, and a run that hits these has fetched hundreds of
+# distinct pages.
+MAX_OBJECTS_PER_RUN = 500
+MAX_BYTES_PER_RUN = 500 * 1024 * 1024
+# Downloads go up to 250 MB live. One PDF shouldn't fill a run's budget, so
+# larger ones aren't recorded and replay as a miss.
+MAX_RECORDED_DOWNLOAD_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+
+_STREAM_CHUNK = 1 * 1024 * 1024
+_TRACKING_PARAMS = frozenset({"fbclid", "gclid"})
+
+Kind = Literal["fetch", "head"]
+
+
+def replay_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Whether this broker deployment may record or replay page fetches.
+
+    Off unless set: Terraform sets it in the dev broker only, so prod carries
+    the code but can never mint a ticket that runs it. The fetch handlers
+    check it again on every request, so turning it off stops a run already
+    holding a replay ticket.
+    """
+    return os.environ.get("REPLAY_ENABLED", "").strip().lower() == "true"
+
+
+def normalize_url(url: str) -> str:
+    """The form two requests must share to match a recording.
+
+    Drops the fragment and tracking parameters, lowercases the scheme and
+    host, and sorts the query. Only the lookup key uses it; the live fetch
+    always goes to the URL the agent sent.
+    """
+    parts = urlsplit(url)
+    userinfo, at, hostport = parts.netloc.rpartition("@")
+    query = sorted(
+        (name, value)
+        for name, value in parse_qsl(parts.query, keep_blank_values=True)
+        if not name.lower().startswith("utm_") and name.lower() not in _TRACKING_PARAMS
+    )
+    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme.lower(), f"{userinfo}{at}{hostport.lower()}", parts.path, urlencode(query), ""))
+
+
+def _url_digest(url: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(normalize_url(url).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+
+
+class _FetchMeta(BaseModel):
+    # Read back from S3, and in seeded mode written by a bench, so a bad one
+    # must read as a miss rather than reach the handler.
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
+
+    status: int = Field(..., ge=100, le=599)
+    content_type: str
+    final_url: str
+    byte_size: int = Field(..., ge=0)
+
+
+class _HeadMeta(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", strict=True)
+
+    status: int = Field(..., ge=100, le=599)
+    final_url: str
+
+
+MetaT = TypeVar("MetaT", _FetchMeta, _HeadMeta)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RecordedFetch:
+    status: int
+    content_type: str
+    final_url: str
+    byte_size: int
+    body: AsyncIterator[bytes]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RecordedHead:
+    status: int
+    final_url: str
+
+
+class PageReplay:
+    def __init__(self, s3_client, bucket: str, dynamodb_client, table_name: str) -> None:
+        self._s3 = s3_client
+        self._bucket = bucket
+        self._dynamodb = dynamodb_client
+        self._table_name = table_name
+
+    async def lookup_fetch(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, ref: JudgeReplayRef, url: str) -> RecordedFetch | None:
+        base = f"{ref.key}/fetch/{_url_digest(url)}"
+        meta = await self._read_meta(ticket, f"{base}.json", _FetchMeta)
+        if meta is None:
+            return None
+        try:
+            obj = await asyncio.to_thread(self._s3.get_object, Bucket=self._bucket, Key=f"{base}.body")
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.warning("page_replay body read failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, type(e).__name__)
+            return None
+        stream = obj["Body"]
+        if obj.get("ContentLength") != meta.byte_size:
+            stream.close()
+            logger.warning("page_replay body size mismatch run_id=%s", ticket.run_id)
+            return None
+        return RecordedFetch(
+            status=meta.status,
+            content_type=meta.content_type,
+            final_url=meta.final_url,
+            byte_size=meta.byte_size,
+            body=_stream_body(stream),
+        )
+
+    async def lookup_head(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, ref: JudgeReplayRef, url: str) -> RecordedHead | None:
+        meta = await self._read_meta(ticket, f"{ref.key}/head/{_url_digest(url)}.json", _HeadMeta)
+        if meta is None:
+            return None
+        return RecordedHead(status=meta.status, final_url=meta.final_url)
+
+    def record_fetch(
+        self,
+        ticket: ScopeTicket,
+        ref: JudgeReplayRef,
+        url: str,
+        *,
+        status: int,
+        content_type: str,
+        final_url: str,
+        byte_size: int,
+        body: bytes | None = None,
+        body_path: str | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Save one fetch. Runs after the response is sent, and never raises."""
+        try:
+            # Only successful fetches are saved. An error page the base arm
+            # saw may be transient, and the candidate gets its own try.
+            if status >= 400:
+                return
+            if body_path is not None and byte_size > MAX_RECORDED_DOWNLOAD_BYTES:
+                logger.info("page_replay download too large to record run_id=%s bytes=%d", ticket.run_id, byte_size)
+                return
+            meta = (
+                _FetchMeta(status=status, content_type=content_type, final_url=final_url, byte_size=byte_size)
+                .model_dump_json()
+                .encode("utf-8")
+            )
+            size = byte_size + len(meta)
+            if not self._reserve(ticket, size, objects=2):
+                return
+            base = f"{ref.key}/fetch/{_url_digest(url)}"
+            try:
+                if body_path is not None:
+                    with open(body_path, "rb") as f:
+                        created = self._put_once(ticket, f"{base}.body", f)
+                else:
+                    created = self._put_once(ticket, f"{base}.body", body or b"")
+            except Exception:
+                created = False
+            if not created:
+                self._release(ticket, size, objects=2)
+                return
+            # Only the writer that created the body writes its metadata, so a
+            # recording never pairs one response's body with another's
+            # headers. That makes a lost metadata write permanent for the URL,
+            # so it gets one retry.
+            if not self._put_once(ticket, f"{base}.json", meta):
+                self._put_once(ticket, f"{base}.json", meta)
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.warning("page_replay record failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, type(e).__name__)
+
+    def record_head(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, ref: JudgeReplayRef, url: str, *, status: int, final_url: str) -> None:
+        """Save one HEAD check. Runs after the response is sent, and never raises."""
+        try:
+            if status >= 400:
+                return
+            meta = _HeadMeta(status=status, final_url=final_url).model_dump_json().encode("utf-8")
+            if not self._reserve(ticket, len(meta), objects=1):
+                return
+            if not self._put_once(ticket, f"{ref.key}/head/{_url_digest(url)}.json", meta):
+                self._release(ticket, len(meta), objects=1)
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.warning("page_replay record failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, type(e).__name__)
+
+    async def mark(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, ref: JudgeReplayRef, kind: Kind, hit: bool) -> None:
+        outcome = "hit" if hit else "miss"
+        key = f"{ref.key}/outcomes/{ticket.run_id}/{kind}-{outcome}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
+        try:
+            await asyncio.to_thread(self._s3.put_object, Bucket=self._bucket, Key=key, Body=b"")
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.warning("page_replay marker failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, type(e).__name__)
+
+    async def _read_meta(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, key: str, model: type[MetaT]) -> MetaT | None:
+        """A recording's metadata, or None for anything but a usable one.
+
+        The broker has no ListBucket on the bucket, so a missing key comes
+        back as AccessDenied rather than NoSuchKey; both are a miss.
+        """
+        try:
+            obj = await asyncio.to_thread(self._s3.get_object, Bucket=self._bucket, Key=key)
+            # Written after this run started, so it came from a base run that
+            # outlived its poll. Serving it would make the replay depend on
+            # timing, so it's a miss.
+            if obj["LastModified"].timestamp() >= ticket.issued_at:
+                obj["Body"].close()
+                return None
+            raw = await asyncio.to_thread(obj["Body"].read)
+            return model.model_validate_json(raw)
+        except Exception as e:
+            code = getattr(e, "response", {}).get("Error", {}).get("Code", type(e).__name__)
+            if code not in ("NoSuchKey", "AccessDenied", "404", "403"):
+                logger.warning("page_replay read failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, code)
+            return None
+
+    def _put_once(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, key: str, body) -> bool:
+        """Create the object unless it already exists. A lost race is normal:
+        parallel subagents and broker tasks fetch the same page, and the
+        first response wins."""
+        try:
+            self._s3.put_object(Bucket=self._bucket, Key=key, Body=body, IfNoneMatch="*")
+            return True
+        except Exception as e:
+            code = getattr(e, "response", {}).get("Error", {}).get("Code", type(e).__name__)
+            if code not in ("PreconditionFailed", "ConditionalRequestConflict"):
+                logger.warning("page_replay write failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, code)
+            return False
+
+    def _reserve(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, size: int, *, objects: int) -> bool:
+        """Count a save against the run's caps, atomically across broker tasks.
+
+        Stamped on the run's ticket item like the data-query counter, so it
+        is shared by every task and deleted with the ticket.
+        """
+        try:
+            self._dynamodb.update_item(
+                TableName=self._table_name,
+                Key={"pk": {"S": ticket.pk}},
+                UpdateExpression="ADD replay_objects :objects, replay_bytes :size",
+                ConditionExpression=(
+                    "attribute_exists(pk)"
+                    " AND (attribute_not_exists(replay_objects) OR replay_objects <= :max_objects)"
+                    " AND (attribute_not_exists(replay_bytes) OR replay_bytes <= :max_bytes)"
+                ),
+                ExpressionAttributeValues={
+                    ":objects": {"N": str(objects)},
+                    ":size": {"N": str(size)},
+                    ":max_objects": {"N": str(MAX_OBJECTS_PER_RUN - objects)},
+                    ":max_bytes": {"N": str(MAX_BYTES_PER_RUN - size)},
+                },
+            )
+            return True
+        except Exception as e:
+            code = getattr(e, "response", {}).get("Error", {}).get("Code", type(e).__name__)
+            if code == "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
+                logger.info("page_replay run cap reached run_id=%s", ticket.run_id)
+            else:
+                logger.warning("page_replay reserve failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, code)
+            return False
+
+    def _release(self, ticket: ScopeTicket, size: int, *, objects: int) -> None:
+        """Give back a reservation whose save created nothing, so duplicate
+        fetches and lost races don't use up the run's caps."""
+        try:
+            self._dynamodb.update_item(
+                TableName=self._table_name,
+                Key={"pk": {"S": ticket.pk}},
+                UpdateExpression="ADD replay_objects :objects, replay_bytes :size",
+                ConditionExpression="attribute_exists(pk)",
+                ExpressionAttributeValues={":objects": {"N": str(-objects)}, ":size": {"N": str(-size)}},
+            )
+        except Exception as e:
+            code = getattr(e, "response", {}).get("Error", {}).get("Code", type(e).__name__)
+            if code != "ConditionalCheckFailedException":
+                logger.warning("page_replay release failed run_id=%s error=%s", ticket.run_id, code)
+
+
+async def _stream_body(stream) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    try:
+        while True:
+            chunk = await asyncio.to_thread(stream.read, _STREAM_CHUNK)
+            if not chunk:
+                return
+            yield chunk
+    finally:
+        stream.close()

+class _Stream:
+    def __init__(self, data: bytes) -> None:
+        self._buf = io.BytesIO(data)
+        self.closed = False
+
+    def read(self, size: int = -1) -> bytes:

+    def close(self) -> None:

+@dataclass
+class FakeS3:
+    """The broker's view of the artifacts bucket: Get and Put, no List.
+
+    Without ListBucket a missing key reads as AccessDenied, which is what
+    production sees and what the replay path must treat as a miss.
+    """
+
+    now: int = BASE_ISSUED + 10
+    objects: dict[str, tuple[bytes, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    fail_puts: bool = False
+    # Fail the next N writes whose key ends with the suffix.
+    fail_next: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    get_error: str | None = None
+
+    def put_object(self, *, Bucket, Key, Body, IfNoneMatch=None):
+        assert Bucket == BUCKET
+        suffix = next((x for x, n in self.fail_next.items() if n > 0 and Key.endswith(x)), None)
+        if suffix is not None:
+            self.fail_next[suffix] -= 1
+        if self.fail_puts or suffix is not None:
+            raise ClientError({"Error": {"Code": "InternalError", "Message": "boom"}}, "PutObject")
+        if IfNoneMatch == "*" and Key in self.objects:
+            raise ClientError({"Error": {"Code": "PreconditionFailed", "Message": "exists"}}, "PutObject")
+        data = Body if isinstance(Body, bytes) else Body.read()
+        self.objects[Key] = (data, self.now)
+        return {}
+
+    def get_object(self, *, Bucket, Key):
+        assert Bucket == BUCKET
+        if self.get_error is not None:
+            raise ClientError({"Error": {"Code": self.get_error, "Message": "x"}}, "GetObject")
+        if Key not in self.objects:
+            raise _access_denied("GetObject")
+        data, written = self.objects[Key]
+        return {
+            "Body": _Stream(data),
+            "LastModified": datetime.fromtimestamp(written, UTC),
+            "ContentLength": len(data),
+        }
+
+    def copy_recording(
+        self, kind: str, src_url: str, dst_url: str, *, src_key: str = SWEEP_KEY, dst_key: str = SWEEP_KEY
+    ):
+        """Plant a recording for another URL, as a bench's seed store could."""
+        src = f"{src_key}/{kind}/{page_replay_module._url_digest(src_url)}"
+        dst = f"{dst_key}/{kind}/{page_replay_module._url_digest(dst_url)}"
+        for key in self.keys_under(src):
+            self.objects[key.replace(src, dst)] = self.objects[key]
+
+    def keys_under(self, prefix: str) -> list[str]:
+        return sorted(k for k in self.objects if k.startswith(prefix))
+
+    def markers(self, ticket: ScopeTicket) -> list[str]:
+        prefix = f"{ticket.replay.key}/outcomes/{ticket.run_id}/"
+        return [k.removeprefix(prefix).rsplit("-", 1)[0] for k in self.keys_under(prefix)]

findings.body:
When both `.json` write attempts fail (first attempt at line 206, retry at line 207), the reservation made by `_reserve` is never released. The cap (`replay_objects` and `replay_bytes` in DynamoDB) is permanently debited even though the recording is incomplete — only an orphaned `.body` exists in S3, and `lookup_fetch` reads `.json` first, so the body is unreachable. Repeated S3 failures on `.json` writes will drain the run's object/byte cap without producing any usable recordings, starving subsequent fetches.

This is inconsistent with two other release paths in the same file: (1) the `.body` failure path at lines 199–201 calls `_release` before returning, and (2) `record_head` at line 220 calls `_release` when its `_put_once` fails.

(Falsification check: searched for any `_release` call or cap-restoring path after line 207; none exists. The outer `except Exception` only logs. `_put_once` swallows exceptions and returns `False`, so the outer except is not triggered on a network failure.)

output.summary: This PR adds page-fetch record/replay for Universal Judge runs, wiring `PageReplay` into `/http/fetch` and `/http/head` behind a `REPLAY_ENABLED` gate. The scout flagged five areas: a cap-reservation leak when metadata writes fail, a background-task timing gap with `replay_enabled()`, a potential DynamoDB client duplication in `main.py`, missing test coverage for the double-failure path, and the narrow tracking-parameter strip set. Deep review confirmed one blocker: in `record_fetch`, when the `.body` write succeeds but both `.json` write attempts fail, the reserved object/byte budget is never released, which is inconsistent with the release patterns used for body-write failures and in `record_head`. The other leads were falsified — the background-task race is a sub-second window in a dev-only feature with no real consequence, and the DynamoDB client pattern is consistent across the codebase. The human reviewer should confirm that S3 lifecycle rules for `_judge/` (#2676) are in place before this ships, since orphaned `.body` objects from the identified bug would otherwise persist indefinitely.
